description:
Create a custom pod template in a workspace, or change one (`template_id` from the templates tool), like the console's Templates > Add/Edit. Use it when the user wants pods from an image no official template offers. It needs the admin or billing role and costs nothing; pods made from it are created and billed through create_pod.
        To create, pass `name` and `image`; the image is read first (see templates `image`) and nothing is saved if it can't be read. A private image needs `registry_login_id` from source_credentials. The image can't be changed later.
        To change, pass only what changes. `env`, `ports`, `volume_mounts` and `semantic_paths` each replace the whole list when given, so start from the template's current lists (templates with `template`); the answer lists what was removed. Pods already created keep their settings.
        `ports`: "external": true gives the port a public HTTPS URL. Public ports are saved locked (only signed-in members and the port's access keys get in) unless the user explicitly wants one open ("locked": false); the answer lists `locked_ports` and `open_ports`.
        Secrets: never put a secret's value here. Mark the variable "secret": true with "auto_generate": true or leave the value out to give it at create time; a secret without a value keeps the value the template already stores.
Every write requires operation_id. Reuse the ID returned by the preview, or generate a UUID before the first call. Keep it for confirmation and all retries; a new ID means a new operation. After a timeout, check operation_status and resource state before retrying.

command.description: Replaces the image's entrypoint and cmd; "" uses the image's own.
command.title: Command

env.description: [{"key": "HF_HOME", "value": "/data/hf"}] with optional "secret", "auto_generate", "show_on_connect" and "from_image" (booleans; "from_image" marks a variable the image declares). A secret takes no "value": "auto_generate": true gives each pod a random one; otherwise it is given at create_pod time, or the value the template stores is kept. read templates(template=id) first (its items can be passed back as they are); this list replaces the stored one.
env.title: Env

image.description: The container image; required to create and can't be changed later.
image.title: Image

lock_public_ports.description: Public ports without their own "locked" are saved locked.
lock_public_ports.title: Lock Public Ports

name.description: Unique among the workspace's custom templates; required to create.
name.title: Name

ports.description: [{"port": 8888, "name": "jupyter", "external": true}] with optional "locked" for a public port; read templates(template=id) first (its items can be passed back as they are); this list replaces the stored one.
ports.title: Ports

registry_login_id.description: A `registry_login_id` from source_credentials for a private image; 0 removes it.
registry_login_id.title: Registry Login Id

semantic_paths.description: Input folders for assets and folders whose files become assets: [{"role": "model", "path": "/models"}] with optional "expect", "include", "required", "cardinality", "placement"; [] clears them; read templates(template=id) first (its items can be passed back as they are); this list replaces the stored one.
semantic_paths.title: Semantic Paths

template_id.description: A custom template to change, from the templates tool. Omit it to create one.
template_id.title: Template Id

volume_mounts.description: Folders that should be on a volume: [{"path": "/workspace", "name": "work"}]; read templates(template=id) first (its items can be passed back as they are); this list replaces the stored one.
volume_mounts.title: Volume Mounts

name: save_template
title: Save Custom Template
